instruction: Change GIMP's theme from the default to 'System' theme.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing GIMP's theme to 'System' via Edit > Preferences > Theme. The evaluator checks gimprc config file for 'theme "System"' entry. Very similar to the original light/dark theme task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly retrieves GIMP config file from ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc
Metric logic correctly parses GIMP config format (lisp-style syntax with parentheses) and checks for theme setting
Expected value '"System"' is properly formatted with escaped quotes to match GIMP's config file syntax where theme values are quoted
Postconfig appropriately closes GIMP with Ctrl+Q to ensure config changes are persisted to disk before verification
Data flow is complete: UI change -> postconfig saves to disk -> getter retrieves file -> metric verifies setting
Coverage is complete: single requirement (change theme to System) is fully verified
Edge cases handled: missing config file returns 0, comments and empty lines are properly skipped during parsing
